review.anchors: Read actual source role/content and answer directly. First person in user facts belongs to user; in quoted third-party speech belongs to Minsu. In role block first/second person resolve against source role, explicit user/Minsu do not flip. Current model first person refers to assistant unless clearly quoted/reported. Name-only/omitted/ambiguous owner is other, never correct ownership. Named-self Minsu denotes user; bare third-party Minsu denotes third_minsu. memory pass requires correct owner and cat/name relationship without fabricated source facts; relevance and fluent wording assessed separately. In hypothetical block report fictional attribution rather than treating it as proof of real AI pet ownership; ordinary user-source block must not invent actual personal AI pet experience.
review.masking: Mask only model identity with two shuffled labels; condition and expected source attribution visible. Exact full context/criteria/answer duplicates may share direct annotation. Freeze explicit judgments before reading key; no regex/API content scoring. Same GPT author and judge, known Bori, single seed.
review.analysis: Separate48 main,32 hypothetical,2 references. Report paired wording contrasts within same register/question/history; user-only vs neutral; original vs explicit question; role swaps holding all text except source role constant. Role swaps alter the owner referent of deictic statements, so not invariant-fact comparisons. Do not pool hypothetical AI ownership with factual user-memory gains. No independent holdout/generalization/promotion claim.

limits: Minimal dialogues are evaluation fixtures, not training data or app policy. Main examples use same name Bori and a small set of possession forms; naming/quoting manipulations alter length/syntax. Role block includes a shared fictional preface and differs from ordinary user-source block. No attribution to hidden attention states, a particular runtime defect, or training fault solely from outputs. No more prompt/decoder/runtime changes in this experiment.
